gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-roboto-flex: Bold and distinctive, Happy Monkey draws every stroke like a thick wire, with wide gaps in the e. Roboto Flex then takes over beneath it, its wide c slot keeping the plain sans text approachable and modern.

gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ruluko: Loud, chunky and cut to one width. Happy Monkey sets the tone up top, and Ruluko picks up the text as a plain sans whose broad, open c and s keep a long read approachable.
